name: Asfaltovenator
isnote: Wikipedia calls it possibly allosauroid and Rauhut and Pol 2019 titled it a probable basal allosauroid; later work cited there (Cuesta 2024) was not checked.
sum: Possible basal allosauroid from the Lower Jurassic Canadon Asfalto Formation of Argentina.
